key_insight: The paper extends shape optimization to thermoelasticity with temperature-dependent material properties and derives a shape derivative for domain-integral functionals.
engineering_relevance: It provides a computational framework for designing structures under coupled thermal-mechanical effects, relevant to lightweighting, compliance control, and stress-constrained design.
method: Derive existence of the shape derivative for thermoelastic PDE-constrained optimization.
Formulate generic domain-integral objective functionals for shape optimization.
Solve the coupled boundary value problems with finite elements and represent shapes with a level set method.
evidence_signal: The abstract reports numerical results for two benchmark optimization settings: compliance minimization with a volume constraint and volume minimization with an $L^2$ von Mises stress constraint.
watch_item: The formulation depends on accurate temperature-dependent material laws and can be sensitive to numerical resolution in the coupled FEM/level-set optimization loop.
paper_title: Shape optimization for thermoelasticity with temperature-dependent material parameters
